## About
Yorks & Lancs Automotive is an independent shop on Canoga Ave in Chatsworth that works on Land Rover, Range Rover, Jaguar and INEOS Grenadier. We serve Chatsworth, Porter Ranch, Calabasas, Agoura Hills, Simi Valley, Westlake Village and nearby towns.
One reviewer calls Jonny and Oliver "Rover encyclopedias." A different reviewer came back because the shop had worked on her Range Rover for its previous owner. We're rated 4.8 from 46 Google reviews.

## Services
- Land Rover and Range Rover repair: Independent repair for Land Rover and Range Rover owners.
- Jaguar repair: Independent repair for Jaguar owners.
- INEOS Grenadier repair: Independent repair for INEOS Grenadier owners.
